entry.title: New PyCon Portugal 2024 schedule released (0.3)
entry.summary:
A new PyCon Portugal 2024 schedule has been released!

We released a new schedule version!

We have a new session: “Introduction to Data Analysis Using Pandas - Part 2” by Stefanie Molin.

Sadly, we had to cancel sessions:

  • “Serving Machine Learning Models with Fast API” by Wesley Kambale
  • “Unrevealing new maps of biology with Squidpy” by Inácio Gomes Medeiros

We had to move some sessions, so if you were planning on seeing them, check their new dates or locations:

  • “Introduction to Data Analysis Using Pandas - Part 1” by Stefanie Molin (Oct. 19, 2024, 10:30 a.m. → Oct. 19, 2024, 1:30 p.m.)
  • “GenAI Beyond Chat with RAG, Knowledge Graphs and Python” by Martin O'Hanlon (Oct. 19, 2024, 1:30 p.m., Workshops Azores → Oct. 19, 2024, 10:30 a.m., Workshops Madeira)
  • “Let's Dive into Web Scraping with Python!” by William Lacerda (Oct. 19, 2024, 4 p.m. → Oct. 19, 2024, 10:30 a.m.)
